title: Radio secrets players
description: Adds new block - radio. There are 16 switching channels
body:
--- # Adds new block - Radio
Radio Adds new feature the game - local communication through radio channels, total channels - 16 ### Radio has 2 types activity: 1. Get activity 2. Send activity ![Radio in the game ( beta )](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9f2d87c166fb86a305dd6617831c6ffab4f932b.png) ### Get activity: This activity receives all messages fromother players ![Get activity in game ( beta )](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79b8a30db838e8a055053553885f13c3585c913f.png) ### Send activity: This activity sends messages to other players ![Send activity in game ( beta )](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba555d39d55c30874824d5f8c2b27c001b3e72dc_0.webp)
Mod in alpha version!
